subject.title: fix(sessions): gateway becomes unusable when there are many sessions

question: Should `sessions.list` be allowed to serve up to one TTL of stale session metadata when another OpenClaw process modifies the same agent SQLite database?
rationale: The patch changes a previously database-backed read into a process-local cached read, while the repository supports SQLite-backed session state that may be accessed outside the current Node process. Choosing bounded staleness versus a coherent invalidation or revision mechanism is an API and operator-behavior decision.

options.title: Require coherent cache reads
options.body: Recommended: revalidate or version the cache against SQLite so external writers cannot leave gateway session lists stale.

options.title: Accept bounded staleness
options.body: Document that multi-process session mutations may take up to the cache TTL to appear in gateway list results.

options.title: Keep only the lightweight projection
options.body: Drop the full-list TTL cache and retain a narrowly scoped light SQL/list projection until a coherent cache design is approved.

recommendation.title: Require coherent cache reads
recommendation.body: Recommended: revalidate or version the cache against SQLite so external writers cannot leave gateway session lists stale.

likelyOwner.reason: Their production investigation and related proposal directly cover the same cache-coherence tradeoff.
